rounds.title: Mint on light
rounds.note: One rule for every control: where may the brand mint mark a control in the light scheme? Mint is 1.33:1 on white (WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1); the ink token is 5.48:1 and in dark equals the mint, so dark does not change. Each variant draws the same controls under one rule. Scan list: plans/ethlete-studio/mint-scan.md. Focus rings follow Q51 (ink) and are not drawn here. Error borders in primary are a separate question.

a.note: Pick. Edges, dots, indicators and text use ink in light; mint fills stay and get a 1 px inset ink ring (checkbox box, switch on track, segmented selected). Brand mint stays visible, every boundary 5.48:1.

b.note: As a, but small-control fills turn ink with a light glyph, thumb or label (checkbox, radio dot, switch, segmented). Strongest contrast; in light only buttons keep the mint.

c.note: Only edges, dots and text turn ink; mint fills stay without a ring. Cheapest, but the checkbox box, switch track and segmented fill stay at 1.33:1 against the panel and still fail 1.4.11.
